purpose: Read-only Phase 0 audit of the mounted navigation page and its directly relevant presentation/data contracts.
primaryGoal: Inspect the selected vehicle's current navigation, location and presence, compare recent speed/distance and presence history, and inspect route details and recorded locations.

dataSources.name: Fleet selection
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, persisted selection and first fleet vehicle precedence; no page vehicle picker. Fleet request forwards AbortSignal, normalizes arrays and retains FAST stale time.
dataSources.scope: getWorkspaceRouteScope('/navigation') resolves vehicle=true, range=false from the inspected route sets. Preserve latest-200 history scope; do not imply an existing shared date range.

dataSources.name: Current navigation/location
dataSources.behavior: location-latest key scoped by vehicle; enabled only for positive IDs, AbortSignal forwarded, 15-second polling. Page normalizes null to undefined before deriving live trust, and replaces content only for fatal errors.
dataSources.unitEvidence: Page comments identify speed_mph as m/s and miles_to_arrival as meters. These comments and consumer conversions are source evidence, not producer-unit verification; backend values were not exercised.

dataSources.name: Recent location history
dataSources.behavior: location-history key scoped by vehicle; enabled for non-null selection; forwards AbortSignal, inherits query defaults, no page polling override or date bounds. Latest 200 is the advertised source scope, not a complete trip or server-wide result.
dataSources.orderingLimit: Charts explicitly sort timestamps ascending; recent destinations deduplicate in response order. Server response ordering is unverified.

dataSources.name: Independent arrival energy
dataSources.behavior: charging-telemetry-latest key scoped by vehicle; positive-ID enablement, signal forwarding, 15-second polling. expected_energy_pct_at_arrival is displayed as a percentage and is not derived from route history.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Aliases PageContainer props; forwards queries/dataSources/actions; w-full min-w-0 container. Existing shell remains header/workspace owner.

components.name: MapsOperationalBrief
components.contract: title, description, scope, readonly StatMetric[], source label/DataState pairs, loading and optional onRetry; adapts raw metrics with useOperationalMetrics.

components.name: OperationalBrief
components.contract: Existing metrics, status, freshness, provenance, scope and actions; compact/loading and details drawer state. Theme-aware semantic tones at lines 63-68.

components.name: EmbeddedChart / ChartContainer
components.contract: Forwards ChartContainer props; embedded surface avoids nested chrome; defaults exportable/fullscreen=false. Existing ChartContainer data/dataColumns at lines 178-190 provide accessible data alternatives; chartKey supports persisted hidden-series state at lines 201-213.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Stable tableId, columns, data, keyExtractor, pagination, compact, controlled sort; mobilePresentation and expandable/renderExpanded are existing detail-preserving contracts. mobileColumns alone hides omitted cells below md at lines 236-248 and 725.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Existing useMotionPreference honors reduced motion through initial=false and zero effective delay. Browser/OS behavior not exercised.

components.name: Existing category primitives
components.contract: LayoutCard, GlassPanel, Badge, Button, Text, Caption, TimeStamp, Skeleton, EmptyState, QueryError, AlertBanner and LiveStaleDataBanner are reused through category imports; their complete implementations were not audited.

components.name: Local RouteField / TrafficDelayBadge
components.contract: Caption/value fields and traffic duration badge. Preserve unknown display and thresholds until an explicitly coordinated semantics correction.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Traffic delay repeats in route metrics, navigation details and the dedicated traffic card; the latter displays the duration twice as a large value and badge. Other route fields repeat intentionally in summary/detail.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep all three sections and meanings; reduce repeated visual emphasis, letting the summary orient and detailed panel supply interpretation rather than deleting source information.

responsive.currentStrategy: Status fields stack then use sm two-column/lg four-column grids; charts stack until xl; route details use md two-column/xl three-column; recent destinations span both md columns. All three tables explicitly select mobileColumns; charts are fixed 260px.

issues.detail: Location history omits latitude, longitude and work below md; recent destinations omits time at line 885. No expandable/renderExpanded or mobilePresentation is supplied. DataTable hides omitted cells rather than providing a row-detail substitute.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobile presentation/detail API, or retain all columns with contained horizontal scrolling. Preserve every desktop field and controlled sort, IDs, pagination, filters and loaded-row actions.
issues.runtimeLimit: Actual mobile reachability, overflow, long destinations and all ten specified widths unverified.

positiveEvidence: Localized section/figure labels; decorative action icons aria-hidden.
Shared Button and DataTable reused rather than raw interactive elements.
Persistent chart keys and hidden-series plumbing exist.

issues.detail: Both charts explicitly waive accessible tables and omit EmbeddedChart data/dataColumns. History is capped at 200, not an unbounded cloud. The visible history table lacks speed, remaining distance and HomeLink, so it is not an equivalent alternative.
issues.fix: Pass source-derived chartData/presenceChartData and localized dataColumns to existing EmbeddedChart, with null-aware unit/presence formatters. Keep ariaLabel, series names, chart keys and hidden-series behavior.

states.loading: Navigation, history charts and tables have contextual Skeletons. Operational briefs receive loading independently or combined. Fleet loading without a known selected ID enters the no-vehicle branch; PageLayout receives the fleet query, but mounted ordering has not been tested.
states.empty: No vehicle offers Manage vehicles. Missing current route offers vehicle-navigation guidance. History, presence, destinations, waypoints and snapshots have dedicated empty messages. Route detail headings remain mounted for a selected vehicle.
states.error: fatalError alone selects QueryError for current/history source sections with independent retry. Charging fatal failure is aggregated through PageLayout/route brief rather than a dedicated body retry.
states.retained: deriveDataState retains payload on refresh failure; operational brief summarizes stale/blocked sources with receipt freshness. Global LiveStaleDataBanner and PageLayout dataSources are also supplied.
states.offline: DataState detects fetchStatus paused; helper maps refresh-blocked to retained. Actual offline UI and request recovery are unverified.

issues.detail: hasActiveRoute is false when latest is absent, so the status action says Inactive during pending/fatal/unavailable navigation. The empty message also conflates an unavailable latest snapshot with an observed vehicle having no active route.
issues.fix: Derive the label from latestState first; reserve Inactive for an observed snapshot without a destination, and explicitly retain unknown/loading/unavailable/error meanings and retry.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / unknown is not measured data
issues.detail: Charging nullable data and successful empty history are passed to deriveDataState without unavailable normalization. deriveDataState treats any defined payload (including null/[]) as hasData; MapsOperationalBrief can report available despite absent arrival/history evidence.
issues.fix: Normalize source-empty semantics explicitly using existing unavailable options and update the feature brief to distinguish unavailable/partial statuses instead of relying only on hasData. Do not discard retained data on refresh error.

issues.detail: The page Refresh action retries latest and history only, not the independent arrival-energy source shown in its summary. The two brief calls also omit their existing onRetry prop.
issues.fix: Clarify refresh scope or refresh all three sources, and wire independent charging recovery without resetting good neighboring data. Retain the existing two-source refresh behavior until deliberate correction is tested.

visualIssues.detail: Traffic magnitude uses fixed emerald/amber/rose-300 text with a bold 3xl treatment; presence and waypoint cells also use fixed light accent colors (lines 337, 351, 387-391). Their hierarchy and composed light-theme contrast are unverified. No neon/glow class was found in this page.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware semantic text/tone tokens and MetricValue roles; prefer restrained neutral presentation for routine values and semantic emphasis for actual warnings. Preserve all status text, charts and user palette choices.

visualIssues.detail: TrafficDelayBadge marks positive delays below 300s success, while the large traffic text marks every positive delay up to 300s warning. At 301-900s the text is danger and badge warning. Repeated values carry inconsistent semantic tones.
visualIssues.fix: Reconcile the local semantic mapping once and reuse it for both renderers, preserving raw delay and unknown/zero distinction; avoid introducing a new application-wide status registry.

architectureIssues.detail: History query is defined directly in the 938-line page while the latest sources use domain hooks. Column renderers, sorting, chart projections and metric contracts also live in this file.
architectureIssues.fix: Move the unchanged history query into its existing domain hook owner under a separately assigned API scope, retaining key, enablement, signal, 200 limit and inherited policy. Extract page-local chart/table presentation only if it improves clarity; retain complete section totals.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 / measured zero differs from unknown
architectureIssues.detail: History independently renders latitude=0 or longitude=0 as missing, although current location accepts one zero coordinate. Current validity checks type and the (0,0) pair but not finite values or geographic bounds.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve the existing source's (0,0) sentinel policy explicitly; consistently preserve valid equator/prime-meridian values, reject invalid coordinates and distinguish missing values without guessing producer behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: ETA is described and handled as source minutes (multiply by 60 for the operational metric; divide by 60 to retain original display). LocationSnapshot still exposes speed_mph/miles_to_arrival/minutes_to_arrival at types lines 2282-2286. The producer contract was not inspected, so this audit cannot certify SI units or authorize multiplying canonical seconds.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the API/SI owner verify and reconcile producer, schema and hook contracts before any field rename/conversion change. Preserve present wire/cache values and display behavior during presentation-only adoption; do not add another compatibility adapter.

first: Preserve mobile hidden fields through existing detail presentation
Separate unavailable navigation from inactive and normalize empty source trust
next: Reconcile traffic tones and lower repeated emphasis
Verify producer SI and coordinate semantics
Extract only unchanged page-local data/presentation responsibilities

requiredSharedChanges.name: MapsOperationalBrief source-empty trust handling
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Source-defined unavailable/partial states are not considered by current available-status selection.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Extend this existing feature composite's status interpretation, not its visual system.
requiredSharedChanges.props: Keep sources: readonly {label: string; state: DataState<unknown>}[], metrics, scope, loading and optional onRetry unchanged; consume DataState.status in addition to hasData.
variants: Existing compact OperationalBrief only; no new surface or universal status registry
dependsOn: Page/API owner explicitly normalizing empty/null source results via existing deriveDataState options
Existing OperationalBrief statusLabel/statusTone and raw metric contract
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Source-empty is not described as available; partial source failure keeps independent metrics and prior receipts; refresh errors retain data; no new defaults or queries.
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Other consumers of this helper were not inspected; its owner must assess them before changing shared semantics.

competingImplementations.detail: Page-local traffic text tone logic competes with the local TrafficDelayBadge thresholds at line 105.
competingImplementations.fix: Share one local interpretation and reuse current Badge/Text primitives.

actions.behavior: Retain URL/store/fleet fallback and shared workspace ownership.

actions.behavior: Existing QueryError buttons refetch only the affected source.

actions.behavior: Retain shared details drawer and source explanations; browser behavior unverified.

actions.behavior: Keep nav-speed-history and nav-home-work-presence identities and all hidden-series keys speed/miles/home/work/homelink.

actions.name: Table actions
actions.behavior: Retain all tableId identities, waypoint value filtering, pagination, shared persisted controls and any currently exposed loaded-row export actions; no full-result export capability inferred.

actions.name: Location sorting
actions.behavior: Initial time descending; same column reverses direction, newly selected column starts ascending.

dataBehavior: History limit 200, scoped vehicle keys, existing enablement/cancellation and independent latest/charging 15-second polls.
Average is computed from positive reported SI speeds; measured history without positives returns zero, missing history stays unknown. Do not silently alter calculation.
Chart projections sort ascending timestamps and preserve null signal gaps; presence true/false become 1/0, missing remains null.
Recent destinations use first encountered unique nonempty destination, capped at 20; retain ordering pending backend verification.
buildWaypoints currently emits only one destination from latest.destination_name; do not invent supercharger stops or unavailable metadata.
SI-aware conversion remains at display boundary, saved distance/speed/number/duration preferences survive, heading normalization wraps negative degrees.
Keep independent route/history/charging receipt/provenance, retained-data error behavior, localization keys, route identity and all empty/error guidance.
No chart export/fullscreen props are enabled by this page; EmbeddedChart defaults both false. Do not claim existing chart export/zoom functionality.
